item.title: TTT 340: Built For Speed
item.description:
Rachelle is back after being off the show for a few weeks sick and what not. She can’t believe what Eric did to the show in her absence; even more dick and fart jokes than usual! Topics discussed include Eurovision (duh!), Speeding tickets and living a life of crime. Enjoy the show because the cops could be knocking down the door any second.

Calgary & Alberta & Canada’s best couplecast. Thanks Scarboroughdude! It’s good that someone acknowledges what we truly know in our hearts.
